hook: KL divergence can never be negative. Except in PyTorch.
hookText: KL divergence can never be negative. Except in PyTorch.

beats.say: Many machine-learning applications compare nearby distributions, where conventional KL formulas lose accuracy.
Across 8.5 million inputs, over 85 percent of FP32 values had at least 1 percent relative error near tiny divergences, and about 30 percent came out negative.
beats.statLabel: of FP32 values off by over 1% near tiny KL

beats.say: More precision is not the cure, but strict repairs eliminate the significant errors on 7.2 million scored samples, and correctly round all 567 million scored components.
